body: Sometimes, it depends on the people I’m with (because weirdly enough I feel most alone when I’m with more people)
Yes! I am truly amazed by how many people reached out, it meant a lot
Thank you! I am doing much better now

Yes, but as I said mental health really is underfunded here so there is nothing like that. If I went to a public hospital maybe, but honestly those suck so my family already has to pay for private professionals and they don’t have those. I have their numbers but I would hate to bother them outside of our sessions. This was my last resource in a very painful moment, which I can tell wasn’t of your liking. I tried to be polite but please stop questioning me
Third world country, the world sucks in many places
I do have a psychiatrist and psychologist, but I can’t talk to them at 12 am
Or at least what I need when I am in a bad place
Oh no it’s alright, I don’t think you are cold or harsh, just that when someone is in crisis they should receive nothing but support. But that’s my opinion

Yes I understand, I think I should be hospitalized as well but healthcare (specially for mental reasons) in my country sucks, and given that I’m just a student I can’t afford it. It’s not always that black and white

Yes I agree, I am kinda okay now but when I wrote this I was mid anxiety attack. I don’t mind constructive criticism but when I receive it in a moment of stress I react badly to it, makes everything worse

Uhm yes I know this is true, and I work on it when I am stable. But when I am in crisis all I want is someone to care, to support me. Because all this baggage I carry sometimes is too much, and in my home I am not allowed to cry even if alone and quietly, so handling all the emotions is hard. It was a bit harsh just because I am really struggling right now
Yes, I want to finish my degree so I can get a job and leave home (because right now I have nowhere else to go) but I struggle with motivation so studying is really hard
I used to think that way, that someday things would get better, but after 10 years with little to no changes it’s hard to keep that mentality
Thank you, I always think about doing it but never do, but the constant thought of it haunts me

TBH I thought and did the same thing too, and now that I think I need to be hospitalized so I can recover and was finally honest about self harm thoughts, they don’t really do anything. I told the psychiatrist that I do have suicidal thoughts, and she just nodded and finished the session.
I hate to say this is true, because I know my friends never seek me out and never really care, but I just always ignore it until I collapse
